bull.t: Multi-year customer commitments improve revenue visibility
bull.b: Long-term NBMs with datacenter and Edge customers can make revenue more predictable than spot NAND sales. Their growing share of bits and contractual financial guarantees also deepen customer relationships and support planning, investment and cash generation.

bull.t: Datacenter growth and flash innovation support structural demand
bull.b: The portfolio is shifting toward faster-growing datacenter and AI-related storage, reducing reliance on consumer devices. Continued BiCS and high-bandwidth flash development can reinforce performance, density and power-efficiency advantages across these markets.

bull.t: Strong cash generation and conservative leverage strengthen resilience
bull.b: Robust cash conversion and low leverage give SanDisk flexibility to fund technology ramps, manage industry downturns and return capital without relying heavily on new borrowing. This financial capacity is a durable advantage in a capital-intensive, cyclical industry.

bear.t: NAND cyclicality makes earnings and cash flow difficult to sustain
bear.b: The recovery is significant, but prior losses and negative free cash flow show that NAND pricing, utilization and working capital can materially change results. Sustaining 2026 profitability through a full cycle remains unproven, limiting earnings durability.

bear.t: Customer concentration increases dependence on major NBM partners
bear.b: NBMs improve visibility but also concentrate revenue and bargaining exposure among fewer strategic customers. A delayed program, changed demand profile or renegotiation by a major partner could affect capacity utilization, growth and cash returns despite financial guarantees.

bear.t: Supply constraints and higher inventory may limit near-term growth
bear.b: Allocation indicates strong demand, but constrained supply can prevent SanDisk from fully monetizing market growth. Holding more inventory to support NBMs and manage component costs also ties up capital and may temper shipment growth and operating efficiency.
